thread:
maria: Hey team — dropping the final hero banner and co-brand logo lockups from AcmeCloud for the marketplace tile and solution brief. Need quick checks: badge lockup, logo clearspace, alt text, and whether we can use our "Redwood Certified" badge on their marketing. Files: Figma <https://figma.com/file/abc123/acme-redwood-co-branding>
lee.design: grabbing now. quick q — which variant is primary? full-width banner or stacked? figma has both.
alex.marketing: primary = full-width for marketplace hero. stacked for one-pager. shorten CTA to "Try the integration" instead of "Get started with Redwood + AcmeCloud".
sara.legal: flag — before we add any Redwood-branded badge to partner assets we need a signed co-marketing addendum. confirm partner can use our trademark at the sizes provided.
oliver.partner: confirmed on our side — AcmeCloud legal is OK with a co-marketing badge but they want to review final lockup. we'll get signature once final art confirmed.
lee.design: visual notes:
- clearspace: 16px around Redwood lockup (see figma page "lockups/specs")
- badge placement: bottom-right, 24px from edge, max width 72px
snippet I left in figma comments:
```.badge { position: absolute; right:24px; bottom:24px; width:72px } .lockup-clear { padding:16px }```
maria: @lee.design can you export 72px and 48px PNGs for high-density screens? also need 1-line alt text options for accessibility and marketplace metadata.
lee.design: exported 72/48 PNGs + SVG, uploaded to figma attachments.
alex.marketing: alt text options: "Redwood + AcmeCloud LLM integration" (short) or "Redwood Inference and AcmeCloud integration — low-latency LLM inference" (long). prefer short for tile.
sara.legal: alt text fine. still need partner-signed addendum before publishing anything with the badge. legal ops needs partner contact @oliver.partner.
oliver.partner: looping Acme legal — will DM contact and timeline. note: partner asked if we can remove tagline "production-grade" from public hero (they're cautious about claims).
alex.marketing: ok to drop "production-grade" from partner-facing hero; keep it in our docs with a footnote.
lee.design: updated hero, removed tagline, pushed hero/v2 exports. increased overlay contrast to meet 4.5:1.
maria: perfect. @sara.legal once partner signs addendum can legal approve for marketplace publish? partner wants next Tue push.
sara.legal: will approve after signed PDF + brand permission proof. send signed PDF to legal@redwood.ai.
oliver.partner: Acme GC will sign by EOD tomorrow and send PDF. they also asked if badge can be used in a joint case study PDF — content team handles that, right @alex.marketing?
alex.marketing: yes — joint case study OK after co-marketing sign-off. content will send draft for partner review.
maria: last ask — can design include alt text and both PNG sizes in the assets bundle (tile, banner, one-pager)?
lee.design: done. bundle uploaded to figma and shared drive: drive:/partners/acmecloud/redwood-assets.zip
oliver.partner: thanks — I'll check and circle back if they want microcopy tweaks.
alex.marketing: I'll draft marketplace listing copy with short alt text + CTA. tagging @product for any compliance notes.
maria: action list: 1) partner sign and send addendum (oliver), 2) legal review + approval (sara), 3) final exports + alt text (lee), 4) marketplace copy + publish schedule (alex). ping when signed.
oliver.partner: on it :thumbsup: 
sara.legal: noted. will review on receipt.
lee.design: moving to "ready for publish" in design board.
alex.marketing: tentatively slotting marketplace pub Tue 09:00 PT if docs arrive Mon.
maria: thanks all — will follow up tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Marketplace publish window scheduled: tentative Tue 09:00 PT (pending approvals).
